description: This source file contains benchmarking code for various convolutional neural network models and convolution operations, utilizing the PyTorch QNNPACK library and Google Benchmark framework. It defines functions to set up and run performance benchmarks for models like MobileNet, ShuffleNet, SqueezeNet, ResNet, and VGG, with specific focus on quantized 8-bit convolution operations.
